hook.note: The door with 13 is open! Before I step out, show me a gallery where your exhibit could hang.

opti.brief: One last field file. Scout a gallery in VR and send your teacher one short video.
opti.desk: No headset? Use my desk. Name each postcard, then write 2 sentences for your teacher.

vr.look: A gallery is a room for showing art and history. Picture the exhibit you built in Lesson 4.13.01 hanging here.
say: If my exhibit hung here, the first thing on the wall would be ___.
One thing I will keep doing as a historian-citizen is ___.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
@PLACE@

In your video, you say these 2 sentences:

@SAY@

Practice now. Say both before the timer ends.

@TIMER@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Centum in Filter environments. Click Optima Centum Gallery, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Scout the gallery
steps.html: Move with the thumbstick. Walk the room. Stop at one empty wall.

steps.title: Record your video and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Fit the wall in the tablet. Click Record video, say your 2 sentences, and click it again to stop.

On the Canvas tab, pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your video, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 To fix it, send a new video.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your video is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? See Having trouble in VR?

vr.full: One video, 30 seconds or less, showing the place while you say both sentences.

studio.title: Postcards from Florida
studio.look: Four real cards are hidden under tiles. Each one shows a Florida place from our files.
studio.do: Tap tiles to peek. When you know the place, pick it.

game.miss: Not that one. Peek at another tile.
game.done: All four named! Florida's story is in its places, and yours is part of it now.

rounds.alt: A postcard of a stone fort with a round tower
options: Fort Marion, the Castillo, in St. Augustine
rounds.ok: Yes! The U.S. called the Castillo Fort Marion from 1825 to 1942.

rounds.alt: A postcard of a canal through flat grassy land
rounds.ok: Yes! Marjory Stoneman Douglas fought to protect it.

rounds.alt: A colorful postcard that says Greetings from the Capital City
rounds.ok: Yes! The state government works in Tallahassee.

rounds.alt: A rocket lifting off at night in a bright cloud of fire
rounds.ok: Yes! Artemis I launched there in 2022.
